mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 65 degrees and a full moon, plus an air quality index of 52.

The City of Verona has announced a new rain barrel rebate program for stormwater utility customers, offering up to 30 dollars per barrel. Additionally, you have until August 7 to vote online for the student-designed I Voted stickers for our November elections.

There is plenty to do in town today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.
In a notable incident from the past week, on July 25, a 29-year-old Madison woman was arrested for her first offence of O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Turtle. The store is currently closed, but they will open tomorrow at 10:00 AM so you can grab your treat then.
